items.title: The Friction Ledger: A Zero-Sum Accounting of Polymarket Order Flow and the Geometry of Event-Contract Fees
items.claim: Prediction market taker fees consume 10.4 times the gross edge of active traders.

items.title: Large Language Models, Price Discovery, and Synchronized Trading
items.claim: Frontier language models improve price discovery in hard-to-read firms despite synchronizing order flow.

items.title: Calibration that counts: Conformal prediction intervals for automated valuation models
items.claim: Prediction intervals from hedonic, boosted, and neural-network AVMs fail calibration worst during interest-rate shocks.

items.title: Heterogeneity by Design for AI Liquidity Management Agents on Instant Payment Rails: A Conformance Specification
items.claim: Shared models among autonomous liquidity agents create herding risk requiring conformance-tested institutional heterogeneity.

items.title: Trade-Policy and Export-Control Exposure, Validated Textual Disclosure, and Capital-Market Outcomes
items.claim: Underdisclosed export-control exposure does not predict crash risk or illiquidity, despite material underlying exposure.

items.title: When Does Reinforcement Learning Beat Naive Diversification? Learning Architecture, Regime Information, and Trading Frictions
items.claim: Decision Transformers substantially outperform both online actor-critic RL and equally-weighted portfolio benchmarks.
